text.p: These are the leading stories in the official Syrian newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Assad receives more cables condemning the ugly crime of the bus bombing in Damascus.
- Syria warns against Israeli settlement policy in Golan.
- Syrian citizens in Golan reaffirm attachment to Syria.
- Cautious calm after Israeli jets raid south Lebanon villages.
- Vice-President Masharqa and Parliament Speaker Qaddoura hold talks with a team of Jordanian Islamic parties.
- American ambassador to Syria condemns Damascus bombing in a message to Foreign Minister Shara.
- Lebanese President Hrawi says Syria and Lebanon chose commitment to just peace that is based on U.N. resolutions.
- Iranian Foreign Minister Velayati says relations with Syria are strategic.
- Egyptian parties to open conference in support of Syria in Cairo tomorrow.
- Moscow and London condemn the terrorist act of the Damascus bus bombing.
